decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at N600-09 (radio and CMMS agree; repair likely 13:30). Norte is already truck-limited: inflow 71 t/h from LH-02 and LH-03 against 66 t/h truck capacity. Ore available by 17:00 (242 t in the stockpile plus 507 t in the other Norte stopes) exceeds what the trucks can haul in 7.5 h (about 495 t). A third loader at Norte would add no ounces. Lending LH-08 from the infrastructure heading is cheap at 0.2 oz/h but gains nothing here. LH-09 is on a critical-path heading at 4 oz/h, so I leave it. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00. No stope is stopped, so no reserve can be activated. No loans.

Norte lost LH-01 and LH-03 (repairs likely about 13:30). Norte trucks move 66 t/h, which is about 484 t by 17:00. The stockpile already holds 243 t and LH-02 adds about 264 t, so Norte is already at or over truck capacity. An extra loader there would add roughly nothing, only a small grade uplift of 11.9 g/t against a 10.6 g/t stockpile. Borrowing a loader costs its home output. LH-08's heading is cheap at 0.2 oz/h, but the gain is still about zero. Central is already truck-limited, with 96 t/h inflow against 91 t/h capacity. Este's LH-09 is on a critical-path heading worth 4 oz/h and stays put. LH-10 is in maintenance until 11:00 and comes too late to matter. No reserve activations are possible because no stope is stopped. Both radio and CMMS agree on both failures, so no confirmations are needed.

Three stopes are uncovered (LH-01, LH-03, LH-04 down, repairs 11:50-14:40 at the earliest). LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.2 oz/h. I sent it to N600-09 (11.9 g/t), which is the richest stope. It arrives in about 0.65 h and loads roughly 150 t, which is about 58 oz; the heading cost is about 1.4 oz. LH-10 leaves preventive maintenance at 11:00 and goes to C512-12 (0.36 h away, 10.2 g/t). It loads about 130 t, about 42 oz. I put it in Central because Norte is near its truck limit (66 t/h against 36 t/h inflow plus 25 t/h from LH-08), while Central has headroom (91 t/h against 63 t/h plus 24 t/h). I did not take LH-09 because its heading is critical path at 4 oz/h. I left N574-02 uncovered because a third loader would exceed Norte's truck capacity. Radio and CMMS agree on all three failures, so CONFIRM-01 does not apply.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
